title: Chapter 1496 - 614: Divine Skills Connect to Divinity
content:
Chapter 1496: Chapter 614: Divine Skills Connect to Divinity

"Yet, this place is extremely suitable for Chun Yangzi." Ning Zhuo’s expression revealed a hint of worry.

Chun Yangzi has a very special status, holding the foremost seat at present.

From intelligence, Ning Zhuo learned: Chun Yangzi’s cultivation technique is named "Pure Yang Pill Scripture," practicing with a Pure Yang Body, using the Yang Sheng Pill, nurturing Dao with pills.

"I do not know the specific contents of the ’Pure Yang Pill Scripture,’ so I cannot calculate this place’s attraction to Chun Yangzi."

"This must be closely monitored!"

Pure Yang Peak.

Pure Yang Palace.

Fiery Red Gold lamps illuminated the walls; the study was bright.

Chun Yangzi originally sat at the desk with a calm demeanor. But when he infused mana into the Jade Slip, revealing scenes related to the Sun Raising Yang Locking Cloud Altar, he was suddenly frozen in place.

Under the golden crown, his eyes shot out sharp beams of spirit!

A great surprise!!

"This, this is?!" His heart fluttered, not yet reading the detailed intelligence, a strong awareness arose—a place of extraordinary significance to him!

"Sun Raising... Locking Yang... Cloud Ascending..." After reading the intelligence, Chun Yangzi’s expression was greatly shaken.

He is a Peak of Nascent Soul Cultivator and has been stuck at this point for years.

He was trapped in a cultivation bottleneck.

But at this moment, he suddenly saw at the end of a long path, a crack opening through heavenly gateways, pouring out light.

This is the light of hope!

What has Chun Yangzi pursued in nearly a millennium of cultivation?

Of course, a higher level—Divinity Transformation!

Nascent Soul and Divinity Transformation, separated by one realm, are akin to the divide between a baby and an adult watching each other across the shore.

Nascent Soul Cultivators may possess the power to move mountains and overturn seas, but ultimately, they remain in the "infant" stage where their mana, divine sense, and lifebound techniques are rooted in themselves.

Divinity Transformation is different.

For those who achieve Divinity Transformation, their divine will manifests externally, and laws become comprehended.

At that step, cultivators don’t merely cast spells but employ divine will to harness heavenly principles.

Each Divinity Transformation Cultivator must possess divine skills. Divine skills are not merely spells of greater power; rather, lifebound techniques refined to perfection, where mana and Dao combine, skills and spirit merge, henceforth moving by thought, and heaven responds.

Nascent Souls rely on mana to operate and consume power in spells.

Divine skill with Divinity Transformation carries a hint of "the principle operates independently."

Mastering the "Pure Yang Pill Scripture," Chun Yangzi’s lifebound techniques have been honed thousands of times, with only a dazzlingly elusive threshold left to divine skills. But that threshold has trapped countless Peaks of Nascent Soul Cultivators.

To elevate lifebound techniques to divine skill levels requires ample insight and talent.

Only with divine skills can a Nascent Soul leap past the final step, acquire a qualitative transformation, and ascend to Primordial Spirit!

Chun Yangzi has made efforts, but despite spending massive time and energy, there was no sign of success.

That is why he shifted focus to more responsibilities in Pure Yang Palace, bearing its legacy.

Yet now, he sees hope for a breakthrough in his bottleneck!

Sun Raising Yang Locking Cloud Altar!

"Sunlight enters the cavern, Fire Vein below, Cloud Qi in the middle, Locking Yang Well gathers essence, Cloud Ascending Altar lifts its momentum. Pure Yang remains unspent, vitality in the fire, sunlight within the cloud, yang within the earth."

"Such terrain reflects and aligns so closely with the ’Pure Yang Pill Scripture’!"

"By cultivating here, allowing me to ponder the heavens and follow natural principles, there’s a greater possibility for my lifebound technique to truly sublimate, reaching the realm of divine skills!"

Nurturing with fire, nourishing Dao with pills.

Refining spirit with yang, transcending with divine skills!

Chun Yangzi was extremely excited, slowly rose to his feet.

The three thousand characters of "Pure Yang Pill Scripture" on the Red Gold Taoist Robe, as if stirred by his emotions, began to glow faintly one by one.

The study’s lamps flared without wind, flames bowed slightly towards him instead of burning upwards, like ministers in front of a monarch.

"This place is my opportunity for Divinity Transformation!" Chun Yangzi murmured to himself.

At this moment, he had not a trace of hesitation.

Whatever the enticement of Danxia Peak, whatever the debt of the Nanming Fire Furnace, whatever struggles of Flowing Cloud Peak’s forces, they must all step back before this treasure land.

He must acquire the Sun Raising Yang Locking Cloud Altar!

"No, I need not act alone; this wouldn’t be appropriate."

"Nanming Village, Nanming Village can occupy this place, indeed must occupy this place!!"

Chun Yangzi’s heart seemed aflame with blazing fiery fire, so intense that his entire body’s blood felt scorching hot.

"I’m the Great Village Chief, after all, I can capitalize on the situation, also seizing the chance to disguise my purpose."

"Others are unaware of the ’Pure Yang Pill Scripture’s’ content, thus greatly underestimating this place’s value to me."

"Once I lead Nanming Village to occupy this place, I shall immediately retreat into seclusion for hard practice, cultivate into Primordial Spirit; then it will be a different world."

"Hahaha, hahaha..."

Thinking about the delightful prospect, Chun Yangzi couldn’t refrain from continuous laughter.

Flowing Cloud Peak.

A hidden Cloud Cave.

Suspended at the center of the cave was a small golden platform, cloud qi surged beneath, presenting a dark red-gold hue like thousands of tiny golden scales settled in the cloud’s depths.

Flowing Gold Guest sat at the edge of the golden platform, arms crossed, face grim.

In front of him was a contract.

The contract wasn’t paper but a thin golden page, with blood patterns wriggling like earthworms, vaguely forming seals of several forces. Thunder Cloud Association’s Thunder Pattern, Golden Stone Alliance’s Golden Hairpin Seal, Suspended Pot Residence’s Medicine Gourd Pattern, Territorial Expansion Alliance’s Mountain Range Seal, Floating Life Association’s Jade Disc Pattern, Bird and Beast Manor’s Beast Claw Pattern...

Each seal pressed in the four corners of the golden page, making this small page as heavy as a mountain.

Lei Wangyue’s purple robe flickered with thunderlight, impatience marked his expression: "Flowing Gold Guest, the opportunity is right in front of you, how long will you hesitate?"

Golden Hairpin Old Woman sat in shadow, skeletal fingers propped on her cane, her voice hoarse: "This isn’t a simple sponsorship. We’re offering to push your Golden Liquid Returning Pill Body to the Quasi-Divine Realm! Such a providence, how many cultivators only dream of it."
